_note: Lines for the farmhouse examine events: the paper calendar on the north wall (one part per season) and the radio on the chest of drawers.

lines.text: The calendar shows spring. A note in the corner: 'Sow turnips early. Cabbage takes its time.'
The calendar shows summer. Morning glories are printed along the edge. 'Water twice when it's hot.'
The calendar shows autumn, with a picture of rice drying on poles. 'Harvest before the first frost.'
The calendar shows winter. Nothing grows outside now. 'Mend the tools. Rest.'

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: An old valve radio. I turn the knob... static, then a faint song about planting rice, then static again.
